stem: Voltmarkt's retail operations manager asks: "On what share of days last month were our bestselling laptops out of stock, store by store?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: Days at 0 units × units sold per in-stock day
Units on hand / average weekly units sold
100 × days that closed at 0 units / all days, per store
100 × (units sold - returns) / units received, per store
